data = self.view.params.data ID = int(data[columnID]) description = self.parent.parent.getChild("General").getChild("Description").props.params.value ### Check if all required fields are filled in if function not in ['new','edit']: errors.append(system.util.translate("Something went wrong opening the screen, please try again.")) if function == 'edit' and ID < 1: errors.append(system.util.translate("Something went wrong opening the screen, please try again.")) ### Check for duplicate description. idToCheck = ID if function in ['new','edit'] else -1 if len(description.strip()) == 0: errors.append(system.util.translate("Please enter a description.")) else: query = "select count(*) from {tableName} where Active = 1 and replace(description,' ','') = replace(?,' ','') and {columnID} != ?".format(tableName=tableName,columnID=columnID) args = [description, idToCheck] notUnique = system.db.runScalarPrepQuery(query, args) if notUnique > 0: errors.append("The description you entered is a duplicate.") ### Continue with code if error is false if not errors: ### Try the following code try: ### Creating or duplicating if function in ['new']: ### Insert the new query = "Insert into {tableName} (Description,Modified,ModifiedBy) values (?,GETDATE(),?)".format(tableName=tableName) args = [description,modifiedBy] result = system.db.runPrepUpdate(query,args,getKey=1) ### Check insert query result if result < 1: raise Exception('Problem while inserting data into table: {}.'.format(tableName)) else: logger.info('Create new entry in table {} successful.'.format(tableName)) #################################################################################################################################### ### Editing a project elif function in ['edit']: ### Update the project query = "Update {tableName} set Description = ?, Modified = GETDATE(), ModifiedBy = ? where {columnID} = ?".format(tableName=tableName,columnID=columnID) args = [description,modifiedBy,ID] result = system.db.runPrepUpdate(query,args) ### Check insert query result if result != 1: raise Exception('Problem while updating data in table: {}.'.format(tableName)) else: logger.info('Editing the entry in table {} successful.'.format(tableName)) ### When something fails, continue with the exception, e except Exception, e: logger.info(str(e)) errors.add("Error saving, please try again. "+str(e)) # if error is true show the error message. if errors: timeout = 20 errors = ata.function.uniqueList(errors) errorStr = "
".join(errors) logger.error(errorStr) screenID=self.parent.parent.getChild("Toast Handler").custom.screenID ata.toast.handler.toasts.toastNotification(message="Click open to see errors.", timeout=timeout, sendTo=self.session.props.id, backgroundColor="--warning", content=errorStr,screenID=screenID) else: ### Close the screen and refresh the overview system.perspective.sendMessage("refresh", payload={}, scope="session") system.perspective.closeDock(self.parent.parent.getChild("Header").props.params.closeDockID)

customMethods.name: removeToast

messageHandlers.script:
from ata.toast.handler import toasts
	# Check for the incoming toast id in the props.instances and get the index of the instance
	index = self.getToastIndex(payload.get('toastID'))
	
	# If index exists either apply exit style or remove from instances
	if index != None:
		if bool(dict(self.custom.animation.value)):
			toastID = self.props.instances[index]['toastID']
			waitTime = int(self.custom.animation.value['exit']['animation-duration'].replace('s', ''))
			toasts.toastClearOut(toastID, waitTime)
			self.props.instances[index]['instanceStyle'] = self.custom.animation.value['exit']
		else:
			self.removeToast(index)
		
	# Reset the props.style zIndex to -1 (hidden behind everything else)
	if not bool(self.props.instances): 
		self.props.style.zIndex = -1

# Check for the incoming toast id in the props.instances and get the index of the instance
	index = self.getToastIndex(payload.get('toastID'))
	
	# Remove toast message from instances if exists
	if index != None:
		self.removeToast(index)
